args: We run a mid-sized dairy in Vojvodina. Our yoghurt and cheese lines lose product when milk quality changes from farm to farm, and we only find out after lab tests the next day. We want to predict which batches will cause problems from data we already collect at intake: temperature, somatic cell counts, fat and protein readings.
note: Live run against gemini-3.5-flash-lite / gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Replay with: npm start -- --replay recordings/reverse-run.json
